figurative_meaning_en: Lacking intelligence; no brains at all in the head
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর গোবরভরা মাথা, কোনোদিনই সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে পারবে না।
এই গোবরভরা মাথার লোকের সাথে কথা বলা বৃথা।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a cow-dung filled head; he'll never make the right decision.
It's pointless talking to someone with a cow-dung filled head.
note: The idiom draws from rural imagery where cow dung is ubiquitous, emphasizing stupidity in a derogatory manner.
